items.detail: Historical WN marking and two apparently unused leads support supervisor. Earlier LDO drawing and mirrored surrogate crosswalk are not a valid RT9818 implementation. Supply/reset routing remains unresolved.

items.detail: 372A has no confirmed manufacturer match. DMC3071LVT is a standard-library topology comparison only, not a fitted identity or drop-in replacement. Three physical pads remain open.
BAV99 symbols currently express a circuit hypothesis, not exact identifications.
All six pads remain unresolved; standard diode symbols already represent them.

items.gap: Internal LED arrangement/polarity and switch common pairs
items.detail: Stock symbols are present; their photographed pad mappings remain provisional.

items.candidate: MMBT3904, BC847B, BC857C and MMBTA55-family PNP candidates
items.detail: Standard symbols are already present. These are less certain than a fully legible part number and must not be called confirmed.

R41 marking is ambiguous; L1/L2 may be ferrite beads or inductors. Unmarked capacitor values are unknown or explicitly estimated, especially RF tuning/filters. C27/C41 also lack a circuit role. No new symbol libraries are required.

19 PIC pads remain unresolved. Existing functional net labels do not establish their GPIO destinations. PIR daughterboard is represented only by its interface; internals are outside the main-board reconstruction.

interpretation: Every main-board catalog entry is drawn. Complete drawing coverage is distinct from confirmed component identity, values and electrical connectivity.
